core.decode: Clipping is measured against the source's full scale instead of the leveled audio, because leveling could turn a clipped file down 3 dB and hide the damage. Cost: score and clip_ratio now take the full scale as an argument, so every caller must pass it.
core.segment: A hysteresis segmenter fed by a signal-level detector instead of a neural voice detector, because it needs no model or dependencies. Cost: it measures energy, not speech, so loud music passes as speech. Silero VAD is optional and the CLI does not expose it.
core.score: Four deterministic measurements instead of a learned quality model, because they need no clean reference and thresholds can change without re-reading audio. Cost: babble noise reads up to 2.7 dB cleaner than it is, and a single sustained instrument can pass as speech.
surfaces.live: Batch runs the same streaming segmenter instead of a separate algorithm, so live and batch verdicts cannot drift apart. Cost: a clip's verdict arrives only once its closing pause has been heard.
